verdict.rationale: Clerky is a software product, so asking whether its core can be self-hosted is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a self-hostable distribution, open-source release, or on-prem deployment option. Every documented surface is Clerky-hosted: the web app, the Partner API, and the remote MCP server at mcp.clerky.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
